captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a stylized advertising blimp. It features an elongated, light grey oval envelope as its main body, a small rectangular blue gondola suspended underneath, and four thin, rectangular red tail fins arranged in a cross shape at the rear. Side propeller pods are mounted on the gondola, designed to rotate continuously on their shaft axes, while the rudder and elevator panels on the tail fins are configured to hinge for steering control.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a stylized advertising blimp. It should include a light grey elongated envelope, a small blue gondola mounted underneath, and four red tail fins at the rear. Ensure the model defines continuous rotational joints for the side propellers and revolute joints for the control surfaces on the tail fins.
captions.factory: The model is built using an ArticulatedObject structure. The main envelope is created as a stretched sphere or ellipsoid, colored light grey. The gondola is modeled as a blue box attached underneath the envelope. The four tail fins (rudder and elevator surfaces) are constructed using thin red boxes positioned at the rear of the envelope. Articulations are defined using continuous joints for the side propellers and revolute joints for the rear control surfaces to allow realistic movement.
